instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: International development NGO implementing water, sanitation, and hygiene programs across 6 countries in sub-Saharan Africa. The organization manages complex supply chains and relies heavily on real-time data to ensure programmatic efficiency and donor compliance. With a large field staff but limited technical capacity, the core challenge is scaling technology adoption while maintaining high service quality.
answers.pastInitiatives: We installed IoT sensors on 40% of our production equipment to monitor utilization and predict failures. The pilot showed a 15% reduction in unplanned downtime on instrumented machines. We now have a business case approved for full fleet rollout, but procurement and integration with our legacy maintenance system are proving more complex than anticipated.
answers.strategicGoals: Growth is our existential mandate. We are losing market share to faster-moving competitors and need to reignite our growth trajectory. We are willing to make significant strategic bets — potentially including M&A, new product lines, or geographic expansion — provided they have a credible path to meaningful revenue contribution within 18 months.
answers.teamSize: The innovation function is informal — one senior engineer has been given permission to spend 20% of their time exploring new technologies and prototyping ideas, but this allocation is frequently interrupted by production incidents and urgent feature requests. We have no dedicated innovation budget beyond standard cloud infrastructure costs.
answers.additionalContext: The emerging market for WASH technology is seeing rapid adoption, particularly in mobile-first data collection tools. However, securing consistent funding for long-term pilot programs remains a constant challenge as donor priorities shift rapidly.

opportunities.title: Develop a Subscription Data-as-a-Service (DaaS) Model for IoT Monitoring
opportunities.rationale: Transitioning from project-based sales to a subscription model provides predictable recurring revenue necessary for growth. This allows the company to capture long-term value from sensor data and offers higher margins than traditional hardware sales.

first_actions: Identify 3 core client needs for advanced predictive maintenance modules
Develop a pilot pricing structure based on data volume and service level agreements (SLAs)
Create a dedicated sales pitch focusing purely on recurring revenue metrics
resources_needed: Marketing resources to define subscription tiers
execution_plan.success_metric: Secure 2 pilot subscriptions generating €150k in ARR within 6 months.
milestones: Q1: Finalize DaaS product roadmap and pricing structure.
Q2: Launch a targeted sales campaign to key institutional donors.

opportunities.title: Optimize and Automate Legacy System Integration for Faster Rollouts
opportunities.rationale: Addressing the current bottleneck in procurement requires incremental improvements to the integration process rather than a full system overhaul. Streamlining data flows will reduce time-to-market and improve efficiency without diverting core engineering focus.

first_actions: Audit existing API compatibility between IoT sensors and legacy maintenance software
Implement middleware solution to standardize data communication protocols
Train the current technical team on new automated workflow steps
resources_needed: Allocation of 10% of senior engineer's time for development
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduce procurement and integration cycle time by 30%.
milestones: Month 1: Complete API audit and middleware selection.
Month 3: Full integration pilot with the existing fleet.

opportunities.title: Implement AI-Driven Predictive Maintenance for Field Equipment
opportunities.rationale: Leveraging the existing sensor data to move beyond simple monitoring into prescriptive maintenance can maximize uptime and reduce operational costs, justifying higher procurement spend.

first_actions: Develop a machine learning model using historical utilization and failure data
Integrate model outputs directly into the current maintenance dashboard for field teams
Benchmark predicted vs. actual failures to validate model accuracy
resources_needed: Training for 40 field staff on new predictive alerts
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve an 80% accuracy rate in predicting equipment failure 7 days in advance.
milestones: Month 5: Model training and validation complete.
Month 6: Full deployment across all monitored assets.

next_steps.action: Establish a dedicated Innovation Steering Committee with defined KPIs and resource allocation for radical growth initiatives.
Finalize technical requirements and cost estimates for the DaaS subscription pilot model.
Conduct a deep-dive competitive analysis on 3 potential M&A targets in adjacent WASH tech sectors.

key_weaknesses: Lack of formal, dedicated innovation budget beyond basic infrastructure costs.
Innovation process is too informal and easily disrupted by urgent operational demands.
High dependency on a single senior technical engineer with limited bandwidth for R&D.
Legacy systems create significant friction in scaling new technology adoption.
